set -euo pipefail
ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 michal@192.168.0.23 'cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps && echo ===GIT=== && git status --short --branch && git rev-parse HEAD && echo ===PROCESS=== && pid=$(pgrep -f "[p]ython.*server.py" | head -n1) && ps -o pid,ppid,lstart,cmd -p $pid && ppid=$(ps -o ppid= -p $pid | tr -d " " ) && ps -o pid,ppid,lstart,cmd -p $ppid && echo ===SYSTEM_SERVICE=== && systemctl status photomap.service --no-pager 2>&1 || true && echo ===USER_SERVICE=== && systemctl --user status photomap.service --no-pager 2>&1 || true'
